snippet.title: Gearplexed Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Enjoy playing with gears?  Gearplexed is a constructive problem-solving game with a variety of gear-based puzzles ranging from opening gates to building factories.  Build gear trains to get the right amount of speed and torque to the target gears and be careful not to lock up your gear train.

Available now
Try the free demo today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4292020/Gearplexed/
